subject: Make missing local response automatically trigger diagnosis
body: Establish automatic coordination anomaly diagnosis as a permanent Doré hardening rule. When an expected local heartbeat/progress/final receipt exceeds its reasonable window, absence of response is itself a failure signal and must automatically enter diagnostic mode without waiting for the user. Diagnosis must narrow the real chain: GitHub inbox -> daemon pickup -> worker start -> subprocess/active command -> dependency/network/permission/timeout -> result creation -> outbox delivery. Each retry must test a materially different hypothesis and persist evidence/information gain. Three attempts are a diagnostic threshold, not a blind hard stop: after three attempts, stop and record failure memory if there is no new information; if a new verifiable cause has been isolated, further targeted attempts are allowed. Persist failed hypotheses, evidence, capability boundary and eventual manual/local workaround so later Doré tasks can recall the failure instead of repeating it. Integrate with progress-heartbeat hardening where available, preserve canonical receipts/product monitor, commit and push implementation plus acceptance evidence. Do not modify locked homepage or Storybook product files in this task.
